definitions.short: Jishvi , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H3440. Yishvi I. יִשְׁוִי proper name, masculine 1. in Asher , Gen 46:17 = 1Chr 7:30 ; Num 26:44 ; Ιεουλ , Ιουλ , Ισουι , Ιεσου , etc. 2 a son of Saul 1Sam 14:49 ; Ιεσσιου ( λ ), but read אישׁבעל as 1Chr 8:33 ; 9:39 (see אִישׁכּֿשֶׁת p. 36:a), compare We Dr and others
